sm_name: Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Limited
voiceSummary: Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Limited has announced that its representatives will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference on Monday, November 16, 2026. The event will be held physically at the Grand Hyatt in Mumbai. The meeting format includes both one-on-one and group sessions. The company confirmed that no unpublished price-sensitive information will be shared during the conference. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. This disclosure is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The information will also be available on the company website at www.mpimanipal.com. The notice was issued by Dattatri Manjunatha Hardur, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

voiceSummary: Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Limited has uploaded the transcript of its earnings conference call held on November 4, 2026. The disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The transcript is available on the company website at the specified URL. The filing is submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited for information and records. Dattatri Manjunatha Hardur, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication.
